observation.visible_scene: A low, fixed view of a gray tiled floor (with grout lines and a few small blue paint marks) meeting a cracked pale-yellow wall, with a darker unfinished concrete column/wall at the right. Bright sunlight casts a sharp diagonal shadow across the upper-left wall and a broad horizontal shadow band over the foreground floor, leaving a lit strip of floor between the wall base and the shadow edge.
visible_changes: The camera position and the wall/floor geometry stay constant throughout the excerpt; no object, person, or tile moves.

The shadow boundaries (the horizontal edge on the floor and the diagonal edge on the wall) drift only very slightly over the ~2.7 s, consistent with a slow change in the lighting angle; the lit strip of floor and the lit triangle on the wall change size marginally.
No editing cut or flicker is present; the segment is continuous.
outside_clip_unknowns: What object or opening casts the shadows and whether the slow shadow drift continues, reverses, or stops outside this cropped window.
uncertain_details: The magnitude and exact direction of the shadow-edge drift are small and near the limit of frame-to-frame visibility; it is unclear whether the tiny differences are real motion or compression noise.
